ps_mp_rule2_body: The Points field shows a warning and Create is disabled as soon as the value exceeds the cap.
ps_mp_rule3_body: Since assignment points are capped, student scores shown out of the maximum cannot exceed the cap either.

tour_welcome_body: Let us walk you through every section of the system — from School Setup to Grades, Attendance, and beyond. Takes just a few minutes.
tour_admin_dashboard_d: Your command center — see a live overview of students, attendance, fees, and key school metrics at a glance.
tour_admin_school_details_d: Configure your school's name, address, logo, phone, and other essential contact information that appears on reports and letters.
tour_admin_marking_periods_d: Define semesters, quarters, and full-year periods that control when grades are recorded and report cards are generated.
tour_admin_calendar_d: Add school holidays, exam days, parent meetings, and other important events to the shared school calendar.
tour_admin_periods_d: Set up your daily class time slots (Period 1, Period 2, etc.) with start and end times used for scheduling.
tour_admin_grade_levels_d: Configure the grade levels offered at your school (e.g. Grade 1 through Grade 12) to organize student enrollment.
tour_admin_sections_d: Create class sections within each grade level to group students into homerooms or class groups.
tour_admin_subjects_d: Define all subjects taught at your school (Math, Science, English, etc.) that are linked to courses and teachers.
tour_admin_courses_d: Create the academic courses offered this year. Courses are linked to subjects and assigned to teachers for scheduling.
tour_admin_student_schedule_d: Enroll students into courses and manage their individual academic timetables for the current year.
tour_admin_timetable_d: Set up the master school timetable by mapping courses, teachers, rooms, and periods into a visual weekly schedule.
tour_admin_add_student_d: Register a new student in the system with their personal info, enrollment details, and section assignment.
tour_admin_import_students_d: Upload a CSV file to enroll hundreds of students at once, saving time during the start of the academic year.
tour_admin_student_fields_d: Add extra fields to student profiles (blood type, medical info, nationality, etc.) tailored to your school's needs.
tour_admin_add_teacher_d: Register a teacher with their qualifications, contact details, and subject assignments so they can log in and teach.
tour_admin_add_staff_d: Onboard non-teaching staff such as administrators, counselors, or support personnel into the system.
tour_admin_staff_fields_d: Create additional data fields on staff profiles to capture information specific to your institution.
tour_admin_add_parent_d: Register a parent or guardian with their contact details so they can receive communications and monitor their child.
tour_admin_associate_parent_d: Link parents to their child's profile so they can access grades, attendance, and school communications.
tour_admin_grading_scales_d: Define your school's letter-grade scales (A, B, C…) and their percentage ranges and GPA point equivalents.
tour_admin_comment_codes_d: Create short code-based comments (e.g. "EF" = Excellent Focus) that teachers quickly attach to report cards.
tour_admin_report_comments_d: Build a library of pre-written full-sentence comments teachers can pick from when writing student report cards.
tour_admin_grade_config_d: Configure grading rules: weighted averages, passing marks, rounding policies, and how grades are calculated.
tour_admin_attendance_codes_d: Define the attendance statuses used at your school (Present, Absent, Late, Excused) with their visual labels.
tour_admin_fee_categories_d: Create billing categories like Tuition, Lab Fee, or Transport so fee types are organized and traceable.
tour_admin_fee_structures_d: Set the fee amounts for each category and define which student groups or grade levels each structure applies to.
tour_admin_generate_fees_d: Automatically generate fee bills for all enrolled students based on the fee structures defined for this period.
tour_admin_campuses_d: Set up and manage multiple physical campuses under your school network, each with its own settings.
tour_admin_plugins_d: Browse and activate optional modules (Hostel, Entry & Exit, Salary, etc.) to extend the system's functionality.
tour_admin_email_smtp_d: Enter your email server credentials so the system can send automated emails for grades, fees, and notifications.
tour_teacher_dashboard_d: Your personal teaching hub — view your daily schedule, recent announcements, and a summary of your classes.
tour_teacher_view_portal_d: Read the latest school announcements, circulars, and communications from your school administration.
tour_teacher_view_timetable_d: View your personalized weekly timetable showing which classes you teach, when, and in which room.
tour_teacher_subjects_d: Browse all subjects you are assigned to teach this academic year across your different class sections.
tour_teacher_take_attendance_d: Record student attendance for each of your classes — mark students as Present, Absent, or Late quickly.
tour_teacher_attendance_chart_d: View a visual summary and chart of attendance patterns across your classes and individual students.
tour_teacher_students_d: Browse the profiles of all students in your classes — view their personal details, contact info, and academic history.
tour_teacher_gradebook_d: Enter and manage assignment grades, quiz scores, and term marks for students in your gradebook.
tour_teacher_create_assignment_d: Create assignments, set due dates, track submissions, and grade student work all in one place.
tour_teacher_report_cards_d: View and print report cards for your students showing their term grades, attendance, and teacher comments.
tour_teacher_input_final_grades_d: Enter end-of-term final grades for your students across all subjects you teach.
tour_teacher_lesson_plan_d: Create structured lesson plans for your classes — outline learning objectives, activities, and required materials.
tour_teacher_diary_write_d: Write daily class diary entries recording what was covered in each lesson for administrative and parent review.
tour_teacher_upload_resource_d: Upload and share study materials, PDFs, presentations, and videos with your students.
tour_teacher_scheduling_d: View the full class schedule showing all course periods assigned to you across sections and days.
tour_teacher_discipline_referral_d: Submit a formal disciplinary referral for a student incident to notify the administration and keep it on record.
tour_teacher_accounting_d: View your salary statements, payroll details, and payment history for the current academic year.
tour_teacher_settings_d: Update your personal preferences, notification settings, and account information.
tour_student_dashboard_d: Your personal student hub — see your upcoming assignments, recent grades, attendance summary, and announcements.
tour_student_view_portal_d: Stay up to date with the latest school news, events, and announcements from teachers and administration.
tour_student_view_profile_d: Review and update your personal profile, contact information, and account settings.
tour_student_view_timetable_d: View your weekly class timetable showing all your subjects, teachers, room numbers, and class periods.
tour_student_view_attendance_d: Check your personal attendance history — see which classes you attended, missed, or were late to.
tour_student_view_assignments_d: View all your upcoming and past assignments with due dates, submission status, and teacher feedback.
tour_student_view_report_cards_d: View your official report cards showing your grades per subject, attendance, and teacher comments for each term.
tour_parent_dashboard_d: Your parent portal overview — see a summary of your child's grades, attendance, upcoming assignments, and announcements.
tour_parent_view_portal_d: Read the latest official announcements and communications from your school's administration.
tour_parent_view_academics_d: View a full academic overview of your child including enrolled courses, teachers, and academic progress.
tour_parent_view_attendance_d: Monitor your child's daily attendance record — see which days they were present, absent, or late.
tour_parent_view_homework_d: Stay on top of your child's homework and assignments — track what's due, what's submitted, and grades received.
tour_parent_view_timetable_d: View your child's weekly class timetable including subjects, teachers, and class periods.
tour_parent_view_fees_d: Check outstanding fees, payment history, and due dates for your child's school billing.
tour_librarian_dashboard_d: Your library management hub — see overdue books, active loans, recent additions, and library activity at a glance.
tour_librarian_view_books_d: Browse and manage the entire library catalog — search books by title, author, ISBN, or category.
tour_librarian_categories_d: Set up document categories (Fiction, Science, Reference, etc.) to organize library materials systematically.
tour_librarian_issue_book_d: Check out books to students or staff — record who borrowed what, when, and the expected return date.
tour_librarian_doc_fields_d: Configure custom metadata fields for library documents such as ISBN, publisher, edition, and condition.
